title: The source invariant and target-open dualizing locality square
statement: Fix the finite purity setting P and d≥0. Let f:X→Y and g:Z→Y be separated quasi-compact finite-type smooth maps of pure dimension d, with X,Z,Y Noetherian and f,g compactifiable. Take a finite-type structure map aY:Y→Spec k, an affine open V⊆Y and affine diagonal geometries H,K. Let N be any normalized compact-support datum. Let U be Noetherian and j:U→X, v:U→Z separated quasi-compact finite-type etale maps with w:v≫g=j≫f, both composites compactifiable. For O⊆U, choose jO:O→f⁻¹V and vO:O→g⁻¹V commuting with inclusions. Let s be sourceTransport of [def-pur-diagonal-etale-source-transport], cj and cv the specified restrictionAlong comparisons, T pullback to O and nuU the ordinary/pro-etale comparison. Set B=diagonalEtaleLocality(N,v,g) followed by diagonalDualizingCongr(w) followed by diagonalEtaleLocality(N,j,f) inverse. Then s followed by vO*sourceToDualizing(g,K) equals jO*sourceToDualizing(f,H) followed by cj, inverse T*nuU*B, and cv inverse. This asserts naturality only of alpha, rho and coefficient-unit change; it has no delta, normal invariant, normal transport, beta or integration map.

proof.text: Apply diagonalEtaleAlphaSquare to the sourceTransport and the specified alpha factors. The remaining comparison between the restricted dualizing objects is restrictedDualizingTransport.
Apply diagonalEtaleRhoUnitSquare to that same restrictedDualizingTransport. This supplies the rho inverse and coefficient-unit factors, and exactly cj, inverse T*nuU*B, cv inverse.

Unfold sourceToDualizing, use functoriality of pullback on composition, and substitute the alpha and rho/unit equations successively using associativity. This proves the original equation with no remaining subgoal.

lean.statement:
theorem diagonalEtaleSourceDualizing (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    {X Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (d : ℕ) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Z ⟶ Y)
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d f]
    [IsSeparated g] [LocallyOfFiniteType g] [QuasiCompact g]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d g]
    [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Z] [IsNoetherian Y]
    [HasCompactification f] [HasCompactification g]
    (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY]
    (V : Y.affineOpens)
    (H : P.AffineDiagonalGeometry f aY d V)
    (K : P.AffineDiagonalGeometry g aY d V)
    (N : Etale.EtaleCompactSupportNormalization P.Coefficient)
    (U : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian U]
    (j : U ⟶ X) [Etale j] [IsSeparated j] [LocallyOfFiniteType j] [QuasiCompact j]
    (v : U ⟶ Z) [Etale v] [IsSeparated v] [LocallyOfFiniteType v] [QuasiCompact v]
    (w : v ≫ g = j ≫ f)
    [HasCompactification (j ≫ f)] [HasCompactification (v ≫ g)]
    (O : U.Opens) (jO : O.toScheme ⟶ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).toScheme)
    (vO : O.toScheme ⟶ (g ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).toScheme)
    (hj : jO ≫ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι = O.ι ≫ j)
    (hv : vO ≫ (g ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι = O.ι ≫ v) :
    let νU := (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) U).mapDerivedCategory
    let T := OrientationRefinement.pull P O.ι
    let cj := OrientationCounit.restrictionAlong P j (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1) O jO hj
    let cv := OrientationCounit.restrictionAlong P v (g ⁻¹ᵁ V.1) O vO hv
    let B := (P.diagonalEtaleLocality N v g) ≪≫
      (P.diagonalDualizingCongr w) ≪≫ (P.diagonalEtaleLocality N j f).symm
    let s := DiagonalEtaleComparison.sourceTransport P d f g aY V H K N U j v w
      O jO vO hj hv
    s.hom ≫ (OrientationRefinement.pull P vO).map
        (DiagonalEtaleComparison.sourceToDualizing P d g aY V K).hom =
      (OrientationRefinement.pull P jO).map
        (DiagonalEtaleComparison.sourceToDualizing P d f aY V H).hom ≫
        (cj.app (P.diagonalOrdinaryDualizing f)).hom ≫
        (T.mapIso (νU.mapIso B)).inv ≫
        (cv.app (P.diagonalOrdinaryDualizing g)).inv
